test_annotations.description: Public-mirror labels; official ground-truth provenance unconfirmed.

resnet50.pooling: Global average pooling before the original classification layer
resnet50.preprocessing: RGB; bilinear resize shorter edge to 232, center crop 224; ImageNet mean/std

clip.pooling: Pooled vision CLS token followed by pretrained visual projection
clip.preprocessing: RGB; checkpoint CLIPImageProcessor: bicubic resize and center crop to 224; CLIP mean/std

minilm.pooling: Attention-mask mean pooling, including non-padding special tokens; L2 normalization
minilm.preprocessing: Matching AutoTokenizer; dynamic padding; truncation at 256 tokens including special tokens

mpnet.pooling: Attention-mask mean pooling, including non-padding special tokens; L2 normalization
mpnet.preprocessing: Matching AutoTokenizer; dynamic padding; truncation at 384 tokens including special tokens
